diagnostics.endpointDeltaQuadrature: 3-point Gauss-Legendre, exact continuous directional derivative along retained endpoints

provenance.method: centered finite difference of continuous P0 simplex Fourier-mode power using retained high/low endpoint displacement expansions; stable endpoint amplitude delta from three-point Gauss integration of the exact continuous directional derivative along the two endpoints
provenance.arithmetic: double-single f32 expansions with explicit runtime rounding barriers and Dekker product residuals; sin through degree 17, cos through degree 18
provenance.dividedDifferences: fixed compare-swap sorting network; local Taylor series for angular spans <= 3 radians (40 normalized terms; conservative factorial-tail bound below 1e-17); Newton recursion otherwise
provenance.reduction: per-cell plus/minus/delta endpoint values written to one interleaved storage buffer; one invocation sequentially double-single reduces each 32-cell chunk, then one invocation per mode sequentially reduces chunk partials
